cases.sentence: Она молила его пресечь ___ агагитянина Амана, который тот замыслил против иудеев.
cases.explain: «злой план» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

cases.sentence: Царь протянул к Есфири ___, и она поднялась и встала перед ним.
cases.explain: «золотой скипетр» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.

cases.sentence: А вы напишите от ___ другой указ, в пользу иудеев, как вам будет угодно, и скрепите его царским перстнем, потому что никакого письма, написанного от лица царя и скрепленного его перстнем, отменить нельзя.
cases.explain: «царского имени» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Write also to the Jews, as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

cases.sentence: А вы напишите от царского имени ___, в пользу иудеев, как вам будет угодно, и скрепите его царским перстнем, потому что никакого письма, написанного от лица царя и скрепленного его перстнем, отменить нельзя.
cases.explain: «другой указ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Write also to the Jews, as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

cases.sentence: И созваны были в то время — в двадцать ___ третьего месяца, месяца сивана — царские писари.
cases.explain: «третий день» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

cases.sentence: И созваны были в то время — в двадцать третий день ___, месяца сивана — царские писари.
cases.explain: «третьего месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

cases.sentence: И созваны были в то время — в двадцать третий день третьего месяца, месяца сивана — ___.
cases.explain: «царские писари» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

cases.sentence: Мардохей написал от имени царя Ксеркса, скрепил письма царским перстнем и разослал их через ___, которые ездили на быстрых конях, специально выведенных для царя.
cases.explain: «конных гонцов» — after the preposition «через», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

cases.sentence: Мардохей написал от имени царя Ксеркса, скрепил письма царским перстнем и разослал их через конных гонцов, которые ездили на ___, специально выведенных для царя.
cases.explain: «быстрых конях» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

cases.sentence: Днем, назначенным для этого иудеям во всех провинциях царя Ксеркса, был ___ двенадцатого месяца, месяца адара .
cases.explain: «тринадцатый день» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

cases.sentence: Днем, назначенным для этого иудеям во всех провинциях царя Ксеркса, был тринадцатый день ___, месяца адара .
cases.explain: «двенадцатого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

cases.sentence: Гонцы, ездившие на ___, поспешили тронуться в путь, подгоняемые царским повелением.
cases.explain: «царских конях» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

cases.sentence: Гонцы, ездившие на царских конях, поспешили тронуться в путь, подгоняемые ___.
cases.explain: «царским повелением» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

cases.sentence: Мардохей ушел от царя, облаченный в голубые и белые царские одежды, большой ___ и пурпурную мантию из тонкого льна.
cases.explain: «золотой венец» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

cases.sentence: Мардохей ушел от царя, облаченный в голубые и белые царские одежды, большой золотой венец и пурпурную мантию из ___.
cases.explain: «тонкого льна» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

cases.sentence: В каждой провинции и в каждом городе, куда бы ни доходил ___, у иудеев было веселье и радость, пиршества и праздники.
cases.explain: «царский указ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: In every province, and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast, and a good day. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews was fallen on them.

cases.sentence: И многие из ___ сделались иудеями, потому что их объял страх перед ними.
cases.explain: «других народов» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In every province, and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast, and a good day. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews was fallen on them.
